conceptZh: 科學家老鼠想用夾子夾起筆畫，夾子自己有意見一直夾錯，最後老鼠用燒杯蓋住它，叔叔玩偶從冒泡泡的燒杯裡出現。
object: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat, a stubborn pair of giant tweezers, and a bubbling beaker with a bearded toy figure inside
morph: a prop-fights-back pair of tweezers keeps lifting the wrong pieces until the mouse outsmarts it and the strokes drop into the glyph 叔
creativeAngle: 道具反抗：夾子自己有想法，一直夾錯筆畫，老鼠最後用磁鐵騙過它；「叔叔」用鬍子玩偶從燒杯泡泡裡冒出來呼應。
promptEn: An 8-second lively cartoon lab clip on a clean solid pale aqua backdrop. The only text in the frame is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 叔, drawn with thick glossy saturated emerald-green strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped. Lead: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat among bubbling beakers; one supporting prop, a giant pair of tweezers with its own opinions. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 叔、叔、叔叔 (ㄕㄨ、ㄕㄨ、ㄕㄨ ㄕㄨ˙); the second syllable of the word takes the neutral tone; slow clear tones, then silence. Moment 1 (0–1.7s): the mouse pushes his glasses up and, as the first 叔 is spoken, reaches for a green stroke piece with the tweezers, but the tweezers snap shut on his own tail-tip ribbon and spin him around once. Moment 2 (1.7–3.4s): the tweezers go rogue, stretching and wagging like a snake, flinging the long left strokes into the air, catching a beaker and juggling it, the mouse chasing with a butterfly net, ears flat. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): the mouse outsmarts it by dangling a tiny horseshoe magnet; the tweezers lunge for the magnet and slam the pieces into place just as the second 叔 is spoken, forming 叔: a left side with a tall vertical, a cross bar, and a small diagonal pair, and a right side hand shape with a slanted stroke and a long falling sweep. Moment 4 (5s): the word 叔叔 is spoken as the beaker beside the mouse overflows with rainbow bubbles and a small friendly bearded toy figure in a collared shirt rises out of it on a bubble, tipping a hat. Final 5–8s: the glyph 叔 stays absolutely still and sharp while the mouse and the bearded toy figure shake hands on the side, both bouncing a bit, bubbles drifting gently, never covering the strokes. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other writing.
